question: Does weak-tone local curvature shrink at matched input radii across independent sources and crossed phases, and what interactions survive normalization control?

design.question: Does weak-tone local curvature shrink at matched input radii across independent sources and crossed phases, and what interactions survive normalization control?
design.source_grouping: 16 independent backgrounds,4 per mixture type. All4 phases, frequencies, radii and policies remain dependent within source.
design.subset_rule: First16 frozen sources4954000..4954015, balanced4types. No model outcomes inspected. Only amplitude.1 and diagonal4 phase pairs; no all16 interaction phase pairs.
design.midpoint: Frequency: explicit chord midpoint. Amplitude: shared analytic center, avoiding384 nearly duplicate midpoint calls. Quantized chord residual is recorded and must be<=2e-7 background SD; it is not assumed exactly zero.
design.capture: Native and background-locked normalizer/inverse on same bank, first/half block outputs only; all token positions FP32 plus32-step forecasts.
design.controls: Exact native repeats, normalizer self-identity in forecasts AND hidden, self-patch, same-batch replay; finite checks, checkpoint/code/bank hashes; FP64 arithmetic from saved arrays.
design.numerical_resolution: Record output FP32-ULP rounding proxy plus measured input closure times measured local sensitivity.10x proxy flag is descriptive, not a rigorous forward-error/Lipschitz bound or an exclusion rule. Keep all rows and sources.
design.statistics: Source-average over dependent phase/frequency cells before reporting convergence. Paired source curvature decrease and sensitivity ratio; descriptive means/medians/extrema and source counts, no p-values or population confirmation. Preserve by-type and per-source results.
design.known_response: Incremental forecast versus known continued injected tone at the two centers, separate from hidden curvature and interaction. No real future observations.
design.execution: One native model process at a time; slot release required. Parent enforces wall/RSS caps and persists failed attempts. No resume into partial outputs.
design.grant_contract: No grant created at prepare. run AND worker require external JSON with this protocol_sha256, explicit_slot_release=true, slot1 or2, and model in models. Supply only after coordinator grant.
design.full_plan: Parked and unlaunched; this new run is a separate immutable subset/addendum.

controls: Exact native repeats, normalizer self-identity in forecasts AND hidden, self-patch, same-batch replay; finite checks, checkpoint/code/bank hashes; FP64 arithmetic from saved arrays.
limitations: Only amplitude.1, two frequency centers, synthetic backgrounds and two perturbation axes; no natural-data or broad global-smoothness claim.
Backgrounds all contain a5.35-cycle tone, close to24h; phase crossing removes the previous phase-alignment confound but does not isolate intrinsic frequency preference from background composition.
Source-average shrinkage does not imply every phase/frequency curve shrinks. Exceptions are saved and remain in every summary; dependent phase curves are not independent sources.
Diagonal interaction phases only. Effects are relative to individual marginal effects and their sum, not whole-state energy.
Amplitude analytic midpoint retains measured FP32 input closure.10x roundoff proxy flags are descriptive and are neither rigorous forward-error bounds nor exclusion rules.
No training-causality or absent-information inference; comparison/feature tests still need matched normalization metadata and input baselines.
evidence_class: Descriptive source-grouped local hidden geometry, behavioral known-signal responses, and within-model normalization controls; no global or training-causal inference
next_decision: No additional native capture. Coordinator may ledger the audited results; boundary/quantile studies use separate slots and protocols. Original full crossed design remains parked.

interpretation: All16 source averages show decreasing relative chord curvature as actual RMS radius decreases. This supports smooth local context dependence in the tested directions, not global differentiability or universal interpretability.
Weak-tone forecast accuracy remains strongly context and frequency dependent despite local smoothness. A low-curvature hidden or forecast map is not evidence that its component semantics are correct.
Frequency response ordering can reverse with background type: TimesFM near-dominant mixtures have lower19.2h than24h response NMSE. Do not interpret the panel mean as an intrinsic universal24h prior.
Calibrated small four-point interactions remain under locked normalization; native-versus-locked effects differ between hidden geometry and forecast response.
